Students must complete 18 units required for the major in residence at CUI. Agreement below does not include all courses required for the major at CUI. Please refer to the CUI Catalog for a complete list of majors and degree requirements: http://catalog.cui.edu/. Also view Transfer Policies/Requirements on the website at: https://www.cui.edu/studentlife/registrar/undergraduate-transfer-credits
